request.spec:
A discount that takes more than 20% off the subtotal (going by the amount actually taken off,
after any cap) needs a reason. Let me enter one with the discount and show it on the invoice.
Refuse such a discount without a reason, and refuse to send an invoice whose discount needs a
reason but has none.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for this implementation's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A discount that takes more than 20% off the subtotal (going by the amount actually taken off,
after any cap) needs a reason. Let me enter one with the discount and show it on the invoice.
Refuse such a discount without a reason, and refuse to send an invoice whose discount needs a
reason but has none.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Discounts that take more than 20% off the subtotal now need a reason, and the reason shows on the invoice. `bin/e2e` passes: all 3 tests, plus the replay of earlier checkpoints' test data.

How it behaves:
- **The rule:** a reason is needed when the invoice discount, after any cap, is more than a fifth of the subtotal. Exactly 20% needs no reason, and neither does a 30% discount that the cap brings down to 12.5%.
- **Entering one:** the discount form has a new reason field. Applying a discount that needs a reason without one is refused, and the form shows an error. A blank reason counts as no reason.
- **Showing it:** when an invoice has a reason, a "Discount reason" row appears under the discount line.
- **Sending:** an invoice whose discount needs a reason but has none can't be sent, and the panel shows an error.

Changes across the app:
- **Database:** a new migration, `V13__invoice_discount_reason.sql`, adds a `discount_reason` column.
- **Server:**
  - `Invoice` stores the reason and works out whether the discount needs one; duplicating an invoice copies the reason.
  - `InvoiceService` enforces the check when a discount is set and when an invoice is sent.
  - The discount request takes a `discountReason` of up to 500 characters, and the invoice details return it.
- **Test endpoints:** the seed endpoint stores `discountReason` and the read-back returns it.
- **Front end:** `invoice-panel.ts` has the form field and the reason row; `invoice.service.ts` has the matching types.

Two choices the request didn't spell out:
- **Line discounts don't count** toward the 20%. Only the invoice-level discount does, which is how I read "the amount actually taken off, after any cap".
- **"Send all drafts" now skips** a draft whose discount needs a reason but has none, and leaves it as a draft, the same way it already skips drafts with no lines.

One gap: the reason is only checked when a discount is applied and when an invoice is sent. If lines are removed later and the existing discount goes over 20%, nothing flags it until someone tries to send.
